flags.description: Init npm project in trail/. Deps: astro, @astrojs/node (SSR), effect, @effect/platform, @effect/platform-node; dev: vitest, @types/node. Config: astro.config.mjs with node adapter output=server, strict tsconfig, scripts (dev/build/preview/test), .gitignore (node_modules, dist, .astro, uploads). Acceptance: astro build succeeds and dev server serves placeholder index page.

src/lib: AppConfig service (Effect Config: UPLOAD_DIR, MAX_UPLOAD_MB=100, TTL_HOURS=24). FileStorage service (blob put/get/remove keyed by id, Layer over @effect/platform-node FileSystem). TransferMeta service (JSON-file metadata store: id, filename, contentType, size, uploadedAt, expiresAt, downloads; semaphore-guarded read-modify-write). FileTransfer service (upload with size validation, list newest-first, get with expiry check -> ExpiredError, remove, download counter). Tagged errors: NotFound, Expired, Storage, UploadTooLarge. Vitest tests against real tmp dir. Acceptance: vitest passes covering roundtrip, expiry, delete, size limit.

src/pages/api: POST /api/upload (multipart formData -> Transfer.upload, returns record + downloadUrl), GET /api/files (list), GET /api/files/[id] (download with Content-Disposition attachment, expiry -> 410, missing -> 404, increments downloads), DELETE /api/files/[id]. Single Effect runtime built once at module scope via Layer.build; errors folded to HTTP responses at the boundary. Acceptance: curl upload/download/list/delete roundtrip against dev server.

Minimal clean UI, no framework. index.astro: drag-drop + click dropzone, XHR upload with progress bar, result card with copyable share link, recent uploads list from GET /api/files with delete buttons. f/[id].astro: SSR file card (name, size, date, expiry) with download button; friendly 404/410 states. Shared Layout.astro with basic styling. Acceptance: pages render, upload works from browser.

Run vitest suite, astro build, then smoke test the built server: upload a file via curl, fetch it back byte-identical, list, delete, confirm 404 after delete and 410 for expired id. Acceptance: all green; document run instructions in README.

flags.description: Deps: @aws-sdk/client-s3, @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner; dev: s3rver. Config: STORAGE_DRIVER=local|s3, S3_BUCKET, S3_REGION, S3_ENDPOINT (minio/r2), S3_PATH_STYLE, S3_PREFIX=trail, DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL_MINUTES. Refactor TransferMeta onto a KeyValueStore tag (LocalKV over fs, S3KV over GetObject/PutObject of meta.json). FileStorageS3Live: put/get/remove over the bucket, NoSuchKey->NotFoundError. Driver selection in runtime.ts via Layer.unwrapEffect on AppConfig. Local driver remains default.

FileStorage.presign(id, record) -> URL|undefined (local: undefined). FileTransfer.download(id) returns {kind:redirect,url,record} when presignable else {kind:bytes,content,record}; counter increments in both paths; presign TTL = min(DOWNLOAD_URL_TTL, remaining transfer TTL), signed with response-content-disposition/type. GET /api/files/[id] emits 302 Location for redirect kind.

Vitest integration: boot s3rver in-process, drive the real route handlers (synthetic Request with FormData) with S3 env; assert upload->object in bucket, download 302 Location, fetch presigned URL -> byte-identical, delete -> 404. Update transfer.test.ts for download(). Curl E2E against built server + s3rver. README: S3 env table, bucket lifecycle snippet for TTL reclaim, creds via default AWS chain, direct-to-S3 upload as future work.

flags.acceptance: Expired records are removed from metadata and their blobs deleted; /api/files no longer returns expired entries; covered by tests (local driver at minimum); README notes/limits updated.
flags.description: Expired transfers are gated at read time but never deleted: blobs and meta.json entries accumulate forever on the local driver (S3 relies on a bucket lifecycle rule). Add sweeping: delete blob + metadata once expiresAt passes. Options: sweep on startup + periodic interval, or lazy sweep on list/upload. Must work for both local and S3 drivers, and expired entries should disappear from /api/files too.

flags.acceptance: List/delete/upload require the configured token when set; share/download links stay public; UI sends the token; behavior when unset is explicit and documented in README.
flags.description: GET /api/files and DELETE /api/files/<id> are unauthenticated: anyone who can reach the instance can enumerate and delete every transfer. Downloads via share links stay public by design. Add optional shared-secret auth (env-configured token) protecting the management endpoints + the upload UI's list/delete calls; when unset, decide: open (current behavior, documented) or deny.

flags.acceptance: No full-file buffering on upload or local download paths; oversized streams abort at the limit with 413; existing tests pass; README limits section updated.
flags.description: Uploads and downloads are fully buffered in memory: MAX_UPLOAD_MB doubles as the memory bound (README notes/limits). Move to streaming: request body -> storage.put stream (fs WriteStream / S3 multipart or stream body), storage.get -> Response stream for the local driver. Size enforcement must happen against streamed bytes (abort past limit), not after buffering.

flags.acceptance: A failed meta.upsert leaves no blob behind; local meta.json writes are atomic (write tmp, rename); tests cover the compensation path; S3 behavior documented.
flags.description: transfer.upload does storage.put then meta.upsert; if upsert fails the blob leaks (no metadata references it). Conversely meta.json writes are non-atomic — a crash mid-write corrupts the store (now surfaced as MetaError, but still bricks reads). Fix: write meta.json atomically (tmp + rename; best-effort equivalent for S3), and compensate failed upserts by removing the blob.
